messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Side effects need urgent attention when side effects are severe, new, or getting worse.
Call your doctor at once if you have:
A very slow heartbeat, pauses in your heartbeat, or a feeling that you might faint.
Sinus pause, heart block, and cardiac arrest have all been reported.
Signs that heart failure is getting worse, such as weight gain over a few days, more shortness of breath, or swelling of your feet or lower legs
Wheezing or trouble breathing
Chest pain that is worse or more frequent than usual, especially if you have recently stopped or missed doses
Cold, pale, or blue fingers and toes, or pain in your legs when you walk
Confusion, hallucinations, or memory problems
Yellowing of your skin or eyes, which can be a sign of liver inflammation
This is not a complete list of side effects and others may occur.
Call your doctor for medical advice about side effects.
You may report side effects to the FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088.
Triplet: ["Metoprolol", "has reported side effect", "sinus pause"]

The relation 'has reported side effect' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug has been associated with the adverse effect specified by the object entity, as reported in medical literature or clinical practice.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'related to': The subject drug is associated with the medical condition or disease specified by the object entity.
C. 'has side effect frequency': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect specified by the object entity with the frequency indicated.
D. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
E. 'has reporting contact': The subject drug has a designated contact entity specified by the object for reporting side effects or adverse events.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
